ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large asymmetrical high-intensity (white) contiguous patches are located on the distal-superior regions of both lobes. The left lobe contains a diagonal white band tapering toward the inner region. The right lobe features a broader white expanse with internal low-intensity black mottling near the trailing edge. The central fluke and peduncle regions are solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an obtuse internal angle of approximately 135 degrees and minimal vertical depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrated boundary. Features medium-frequency pixel-amplitude variations along the lobes, with prominent high-amplitude peaks at both distal terminals caused by biological encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory from the median notch to the outer lobe midpoints, transitioning to a slight concavity approaching the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel aggregates (barnacle colonies) located on the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Sparse white circular mottling is visible within the posterior black region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of parallel vertical white linear marks (rake marks) on the lower-central black region of the left lobe. Smaller, unaligned linear scratches are visible across the central black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible multi-line rake marks on the left lobe and significant barnacle colonization on both fluke terminals.
